prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1166; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center and the left quarter panel shows a crease that runs into the trunk lid, which is consistent with the reported rear impact. The lower reinforcement bar is bent, and the tail lamp housing on the driver side has broken away from its mount. No prior damage has come to light in the inspection, and the paint film shows no sign of earlier repairs. The plan is to replace the bumper cover and tail lamp, straighten the quarter panel, and refinish the affected areas. Two similar charges posted to the file on the same day are being verified before payment. The labor hours are slightly high for this scope of work and are under review with the shop.
